architecture_summary: Static React portfolio. Single-page app. TailwindCSS for styling. Dark-orange luxury theme. No backend. Data static JSON files. Mobile-first responsive grid. Hero, marquee, services, projects, explore, footer sections.

tickets.title: Hero landing section (src/pages/Home/Hero.jsx)
tickets.description: Build hero landing. Dark-orange gradient background. Centered luxury typography. Animated scroll-down chevron. Responsive layout.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind classes: bg-gradient-to-b from-orange-900 to-orange-700, text-amber-100

tickets.title: Marquee about section (src/components/Marquee.jsx)
tickets.description: Build marquee. Infinite horizontal scroll. Luxury serif text. Dark-orange background. Pause on hover.

tickets.title: Services showcase section (src/pages/Home/Services.jsx)
tickets.description: Build services grid. 3-column desktop, 1-column mobile. Dark card background. Hover scale effect. Static data from src/data/services.json.

tickets.title: Projects showcase section (src/pages/Home/Projects.jsx)
tickets.description: Build projects grid. Masonry layout. Dark-orange overlay on hover. Static data from src/data/projects.json.
acceptance_criteria: Hover: overlay with project name, bg-orange-800/80

tickets.title: Explore section (src/pages/Home/Explore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build explore CTA. Full-width dark-orange banner. Centered button. Link to external contact.

tickets.title: Collection footer (src/components/Footer.jsx)
tickets.description: Build footer. 3-column links. Dark-orange background. Copyright text. Social icons.

tickets.title: Dark-orange luxury theme (src/styles/theme.js)
tickets.description: Configure Tailwind theme. Dark-orange palette. Luxury typography. Custom animations.
acceptance_criteria: Colors: orange-50 to orange-900, amber-50 to amber-200

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire all sections. Dark background. Smooth scroll. Mobile menu toggle. Import all page components.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile menu: hamburger icon, toggle visibility
